summary.result: The results also showed that the influences of different ET methods applications on the water supply reliability of reservoirs are negligible for the cases of over 3.7 watershed ratio and 670 mm unit reservoir storage, while significant variations of the results obtain from the applications between two ET approaches for the opposite cases.
summary.background: The modified Penman (MP), traditional method, and the Penman-Monteith (PM), the new adopted method, were applied on 149 reservoirs located in Honam province for this study.
summary.method: For the comparisons of application results of two ET approaches, the PM method showed lower ET and IWR, and hence more reliable storage capacity of the reservoirs respect to water supply to paddy fields.

summary_ko.background: 수정 Penman(MP), 전통적 방법, 그리고 Penman-Monteith(PM), 새로운 도입 방법은 본 연구에 있어 호남도 내에 위치한 149개 저수지에 적용되었다.

summary_ko.result: 또한 결과는, 3.7 유역비율과 670 mm 단위 저류량의 경우, 다양한 증발산량 방법의 적용이 저수지 용수안전도에 미치는 영향은 무시할 수준이었으나, 반대의 경우 두 가지 증발산량 방법의 적용에 따른 결과가 유의미하게 달라졌음을 보여주었다.
